questions.question: Under IAS 36 (Impairment of Assets), a cash-generating unit (CGU) has a carrying amount of $1,200,000. Its value in use is determined to be $950,000, and its fair value less costs of disposal is $1,000,000. Included in the CGU's carrying amount is goodwill of $150,000. What is the carrying amount of goodwill after allocating the impairment loss?

On January 1, Year 1, a corporation issued $1,000,000 face amount of 5-year, 6% bonds for $920,150, yielding an effective interest rate of 8%. Interest is payable annually on December 31. Using the effective interest method, what amount of interest expense should the corporation report in its income statement for the year ended December 31, Year 1?

Under IAS 37 (Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets), how should an entity account for a present obligation arising from a past event when an outflow of resources embodying economic benefits is deemed probable (more likely than not) and the obligation can be measured with sufficient reliability?
options: Disclose the situation in the financial statement notes as a contingent liability.
Recognize a provision as a liability in the statement of financial position.
Defer recognition until the cash outflow actually occurs.
Record a direct debit to equity without impacting current period profit or loss.

questions.question: At the end of Year 1, a firm purchases equipment for $500,000. For financial reporting, straight-line depreciation over 5 years with no salvage value is used ($100,000 per year). For tax purposes, accelerated tax depreciation permits a 40% deduction in Year 1 ($200,000). Assuming an enacted income tax rate of 25%, what deferred tax balance should be recognized at the end of Year 1?

An entity had 100,000 ordinary shares outstanding at the beginning of the fiscal year. On April 1, it issued 20,000 new ordinary shares for cash. On October 1, it repurchased 10,000 shares as treasury stock. What is the weighted average number of ordinary shares to be used in calculating basic earnings per share (EPS) for the full fiscal year ended December 31?
